text: something light after a heavy training session
our cooktop is broken and we are waiting on the repair
I have honestly never made a meal in my life
freezing outside, I want something that warms you up
feeding a lot of people without spending much
nothing from an animal, not even butter or milk
the kitchen is packed up and the power is off
something with a real kick to it
bringing a dish to share at a neighbour's party
a treat to finish the evening on
a lazy weekend late morning meal
cheap protein that is not meat
it is the middle of a heatwave
a light fruity dessert to end a summer lunch
an ice-cold drink to cool down with
a big bowl of pasta for a hungry family
